absent: Locking, RCU and preemption rules for concurrent radix tree access, tag walks and iterator use.
Numeric values and widths for tag shifts, map size, tag counts, distance sentinel and error codes.
Complete memory layouts for tree root, node, iterator, identifier, codetag and processor map structures.
Allocation failure, growth and shrink behaviour for compat tables, mask variables and tree height beyond shown fragments.
Initialisation, teardown and cross module ordering for codetag types and interrupt affinity bindings.

findings.text: Iterator tag clear exposes a public operation that clears one tag at the position recorded in an iterator, delegating to node level clearing using the iterator node and masked index.
Tree tagged query exposes a public predicate that reports whether a root level aggregated tag is currently set.

Free slot search exposes a public allocator helper that selects an identifier slot at or after a requested start bounded by a maximum, initialising iterator position and tag window for the chosen slot.
Deletion helpers expose public removal of an entry by index, with an identifier wrapper that adjusts by a base offset before delegating to the indexed deletion routine.
Processor mapping helpers expose creation, reference handling, object insertion and affinity driven remapping, plus interrupt glue helpers that attach, detach and release notifier bindings.
Codetag module helpers expose queries for section need, allocation and release of module sections, replacement notification, and load and unload handling for tracking module ranges.
Mask and stack helpers expose node aware mask allocation with failure indication, mask release, and a stack dump entry that forwards a default level.
Root aggregated tags are held as shifted bits inside a flags word, with set, clear and test operations using the same tag plus shift displacement.

Node tag clearing walks toward the root only while the current bit was set, stopping early when the bit was already clear or when sibling bits for the same tag remain, and finally clears the root bit only when no aggregated bit remains.
Node tag setting walks toward the root only while the current bit was clear, stopping when already set, and ensures the root bit ends set.
Slot offset is zero when no parent node exists, otherwise it is the distance between the slot pointer and the parent slot array base.
Compatibility audit class tables each list numeric identifiers and are terminated by an all bits set unsigned sentinel value.

Processor map creation rejects sizes above sixteen bit range, places the object pointer array after the aligned header, and seeds every possible processor with round robin assignment at infinite distance.

Deletion distinguishes identifier trees from generic trees by setting a free marker in the former and clearing all tags in the latter, then replaces the slot with null while decrementing occupancy and value counts.
Codetag type list traversal holds a global mutex, and each per type section decision or mutation additionally holds that type write guard around the callback, releasing in reverse order.
Codetag load and unload serialize type list changes under a global mutex while module identity updates for each type occur under that type write guard.
Interrupt glue groups an affinity notifier with a back pointer to the containing map and a sixteen bit object index.
Fresh tree nodes record shift, slot offset, occupancy and value counts, parent linkage and owning root.
Iterator tag state for a null node is a single set bit, otherwise it carries a shifted window of tag bits from the node bitmap with chunk size clipping when multiple words exist.

Free search cycles through load root, skip occupied prefix when no free mark exists, enforce upper bound, extend height when beyond current coverage, descend creating marked nodes as needed, scan forward for marked bits, ascend and restart growth when a level overflows, then publish iterator bounds.

Tree extension computes required height from the target index, then repeatedly inserts a new level above the old head propagating identifier free marks or generic aggregated tags until coverage suffices.

Affinity remap proceeds through invalidation of entries pointing at the target, seeding of the new affinity set at zero distance plus node expansion, then topology ordered neighbour inheritance across sibling, core and node scopes.
Stack dump entry provides a visible no argument routine that requests a dump at default verbosity.

Free search signals exhaustion or allocation failure with encoded error pointers for out of space and out of memory, including start beyond maximum, forward scan overflow, level overflow at zero, and node creation failure.
Node allocation uses a per processor preload reserve only when blocking is disallowed outside interrupt context, otherwise it allocates directly from the node cache.
Affinity update can fail when its temporary mask cannot be allocated, and affinity notification only logs such failures without further propagation.
Module unload waits for deferred reclamation to drain before mutating tracking state, and guarded section release runs only after the type lock is dropped.
Codetag module section names use prefix dot codetag dot.

Occupancy delta for identifier trees depends on the free mark at the target offset, yielding no change when occupied, otherwise indicating creation versus replacement, while generic trees use presence difference between new and old entries.
Reference release frees the containing map, and object insertion scans linearly for the first empty position, reporting no space when none remains.
Diagnostic dump of processor to object assignments exists in two build variants, one emitting per processor mapping lines and one performing no action.
Tag read selects the node bitmap when a node is present and otherwise falls back to the root aggregated bit.
